_doc: Evidence-named variables for SPBATTLE (lane mod-spbattle). Key = DS address hex (A<base> arrays, SUB<addr> subs, FN<addr>/FN<addr>_args DEF FNs); <key>_why = evidence. A<base>_count = element count of a static local array (evidence in A<base>_why); qb2bas renders every direct DS address inside an array range (COMMON descriptors or A<base>_count) as the element `Name(index)` - a constant index the compiler folded into a direct operand (sweep-folded, 2026-10-16); such addresses therefore carry no name key, only a _why.
